subject: Redwood pilot: brief recap + proposed next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@fintegra.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot: brief recap + proposed next steps

Hi Ellie / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and a clear next step: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for customer-facing recommendations while keeping 99th-pct latency under 150ms.
- Workload: ~2.5M inference calls/day (peak bursts at 1.2k r/s), short prompts (avg 60 tokens output), stateful chat for sessionized users.
- Constraints: data residency in us-east, SOC 2 & contract terms matter to procurement.

Proposed next steps
1) Pilot: 4-week dedicated pilot on Redwood Dedicated (small pool, us-east) to measure latency/cost delta vs current stack.
2) Tech kickoff: Priyom to run a 60-min integration session (instruments, KV cache recommendations, token accounting).
3) Commercial: we’ll share a short pilot proposal + success criteria and a procurement checklist.

Deliverables I attached: fintegra-pilot-proposal.pdf (outline, pricing for 4-week pilot), redwood-technical-runbook.pdf (integration checklist).

Can you confirm: 1) pilot scope looks right, and 2) two possible kickoff windows next week (Tue 6/8 10:00am ET or Thu 6/10 2:00pm ET)?

If those don’t work, tell us a time that fits and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to getting a quick test running.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128

Attachment: fintegra-pilot-proposal.pdf (PDF, 124KB stub)
Attachment: redwood-technical-runbook.pdf (PDF, 98KB stub)

Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: quick follow-up on pilot scope (re: Redwood pilot: brief recap + proposed next steps)

Hi Ellie —

Wanted to bump this in case it got buried. We haven’t heard back on the proposed pilot scope or the two kickoff slots I suggested. Quick reminder of the asks:
- Confirm pilot scope (4-week Dedicated pilot, us-east)
- Pick one kickoff slot (Tue 6/8 10:00am ET or Thu 6/10 2:00pm ET) or propose an alternative

If the pilot isn’t a priority right now, a one-line reply with the expected timing (e.g., Q3) would be helpful so we don’t keep pinging.

I’m happy to make the kickoff lighter — 30 minutes to walk the architecture is fine too.

Thanks,
Connor

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: quick tech offer — happy to run a sandbox integration (re: Redwood pilot)

Hi Ellie —

I’m Priyom, the solutions engineer Connor copied on the pilot. If it helps move things along, I can: 
- Spin up a short sandbox connector (2–3 hours) to show expected latency and token usage with one representative model.
- Walk through a lightweight instrument plan so you can measure cost per session in your telemetry.

No commitment from your side — I’ll just need a sample prompt pattern and a dev endpoint. If you’re interested, ping me a good time and I’ll block 45 minutes.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

Ellie / Marcus —

Quick one: we haven’t seen a reply to the pilot proposal or the two kickoff slots. Totally understand priorities shift.

If I don’t hear back by end of day Friday (6/25), I’ll close this file on our side to avoid ongoing follow-ups. If you want more time, just reply with a quick note or propose a month (e.g., Q3) and I’ll mark it as on-hold.

If there are any procurement or compliance hurdles I can help surface (SOC 2 evidence, data residency notes), say the word and we’ll loop in the relevant folks.

Thanks for considering Redwood — happy to re-open whenever the timing is right.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
